name: Talking Heads

whyMatters.en: RISD friends Byrne, Frantz, and Weymouth formed in New York in 1975; CBGB opening for Ramones that June led to Sire. Brian Eno produced More Songs About Buildings and Food, Fear of Music, and Remain in Light (1980).
whyMatters.zh: Byrne、Frantz、Weymouth 在罗德岛设计学院结识，1975 年于纽约成军；同年 6 月在 CBGB 为 Ramones 暖场后签入 Sire。Brian Eno 制作《More Songs About Buildings and Food》《Fear of Music》与《Remain in Light》（1980）。

shortBio.en: Byrne / Harrison / Weymouth / Frantz new wave, 1975–1991. Sire via CBGB; Eno on three albums; Once in a Lifetime is the mass entry.
shortBio.zh: Byrne / Harrison / Weymouth / Frantz 的 new wave，1975–1991。经 CBGB 签入 Sire；Eno 制作三张专辑；《Once in a Lifetime》是大众入口。

body.en:
David Byrne, Chris Frantz, and Tina Weymouth met at Rhode Island School of Design; Byrne and Frantz briefly played in The Artistics. They moved to Manhattan in 1974. Weymouth joined on bass. In June 1975 they opened for Ramones at CBGB and took the name Talking Heads. Seymour Stein signed them to Sire. Debut single Love → Building on Fire arrived February 1977; Jerry Harrison (ex–Jonathan Richman and the Modern Lovers) joined on keyboards soon after.

Talking Heads: 77 and Psycho Killer set nervous funk. On a 1977 spring tour with Ramones they met Brian Eno (ex–Roxy Music) in London. Eno recorded King’s Lead Hat—an anagram of Talking Heads—on Before and After Science (1977), then produced More Songs About Buildings and Food (1978), including a cover of Al Green’s Take Me to the River; Fear of Music (1979); and Remain in Light (1980), his last Heads album, which yielded Once in a Lifetime. Byrne and Eno also made My Life in the Bush of Ghosts; Frantz and Weymouth formed Tom Tom Club (Genius of Love).

Speaking in Tongues (1983) brought Burning Down the House (US No. 9). Jonathan Demme’s concert film Stop Making Sense (1984) and its soundtrack followed. Little Creatures (1985) and True Stories (1986) sat in the MTV era; a True Stories song later gave Oxford’s On a Friday—Radiohead—its name. Naked (1988) leaned toward world music (UK Top 3, US Top 20). The band dissolved in 1991. A Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction set in 2002 was a brief reunion.
body.zh:
David Byrne、Chris Frantz 与 Tina Weymouth 在罗德岛设计学院结识；Byrne 与 Frantz 曾短暂加入 The Artistics。1974 年迁至曼哈顿，Weymouth 担任贝斯。1975 年 6 月在 CBGB 为 Ramones 暖场并定名 Talking Heads。Seymour Stein 签入 Sire。首支单曲《Love → Building on Fire》于 1977 年 2 月发行；不久 Jerry Harrison（前 Jonathan Richman and the Modern Lovers）加入键盘。

《Talking Heads: 77》与《Psycho Killer》确立紧张 funk。1977 年春与 Ramones 巡演时在伦敦遇见 Brian Eno（前 Roxy Music）。Eno 在《Before and After Science》（1977）录了《King's Lead Hat》（Talking Heads 的变形词），并制作《More Songs About Buildings and Food》（1978，含 Al Green《Take Me to the River》翻唱）、《Fear of Music》（1979）与《Remain in Light》（1980，其最后一张 Heads 制作，含《Once in a Lifetime》）。Byrne 与 Eno 另作《My Life in the Bush of Ghosts》；Frantz 与 Weymouth 组成 Tom Tom Club（《Genius of Love》）。

《Speaking in Tongues》（1983）带来《Burning Down the House》（美国榜第 9）。Jonathan Demme 执导现场纪录片《Stop Making Sense》（1984）及同名专辑。《Little Creatures》（1985）与《True Stories》（1986）进入 MTV 时期；后者中一首歌后来成为牛津 On a Friday——即 Radiohead——的队名。《Naked》（1988）偏向世界音乐（英国榜前 3、美国榜前 20）。乐队于 1991 年解散。2002 年入选摇滚名人堂时做过一次重组演出。

title.en: Art-school funk into Eno studio density
title.zh: 艺术学院 funk 进入 Eno 录音室密度

body.en:
CBGB short sets and Weymouth–Frantz groove meet Eno’s layered production on More Songs, Fear of Music, and Remain in Light.

Dance grid stays; studio parts multiply.
body.zh:
CBGB 短现场与 Weymouth–Frantz 的 groove，接到 Eno 在《More Songs》《Fear of Music》《Remain in Light》上的分层制作。

舞曲网格保留；录音室声部增多。

title.en: RISD trio to four; Sire and Eno
title.zh: RISD 三人到四人；Sire 与 Eno

body.en:
Byrne, Frantz, Weymouth: RISD friends, June 1975 CBGB open for Ramones, Sire via Seymour Stein. Harrison joins 1977 from Modern Lovers. Public lineup stays four through 1991; Remain in Light adds studio layers.

Side paths: Byrne–Eno Bush of Ghosts; Frantz–Weymouth Tom Tom Club.
body.zh:
Byrne、Frantz、Weymouth：RISD 友人，1975 年 6 月 CBGB 为 Ramones 暖场，经 Seymour Stein 进 Sire。Harrison 1977 年自 Modern Lovers 加入。公众阵容至 1991 年仍为四人；《Remain in Light》加录音室分层。

旁支：Byrne–Eno《Bush of Ghosts》；Frantz–Weymouth 的 Tom Tom Club。

body.en:
Spoken-sung verses over interlocking bass, guitar, and keys on Remain in Light. Last Eno-produced Heads album; internal tension between Byrne–Eno and Frantz–Weymouth is documented around these sessions.

Clear entry for the layered method.
body.zh:
《Remain in Light》上互锁贝斯、吉他与键盘的说唱主歌。Eno 制作的最后一张 Heads 专辑；Byrne–Eno 与 Frantz–Weymouth 之间的紧张在这一时期有记载。

分层方法的清楚入口。

title.en: Byrne angle, Weymouth pocket, Harrison keys
title.zh: Byrne 棱角，Weymouth 律动，Harrison 键盘

body.en:
Byrne’s angular guitar and nervous baritone sit on Weymouth’s melodic funk bass and Frantz’s dry kick. Harrison adds keys and guitar after 1977.

Tom Tom Club shows the rhythm section can carry a separate hit catalog (Genius of Love).
body.zh:
Byrne 棱角吉他与紧张男中音坐在 Weymouth 旋律 funk 贝斯与 Frantz 干底鼓上。1977 年后 Harrison 加键盘与吉他。

Tom Tom Club 显示节奏组可承载独立热单目录（《Genius of Love》）。

title.en: Stop Making Sense and MTV years

body.en:
Jonathan Demme’s Stop Making Sense (1984) documents the expanded live band and Byrne’s oversized suit. Little Creatures (1985; Road to Nowhere in the UK) and True Stories (1986) sit in the video era. Naked (1988) turns toward world music before the 1991 split.

2002 Hall of Fame induction included a reunion set.
body.zh:
Jonathan Demme 的《Stop Making Sense》（1984）记录扩编现场乐队与 Byrne 宽大西装。《Little Creatures》（1985；英国热单《Road to Nowhere》）与《True Stories》（1986）处于影像时代。《Naked》（1988）转向世界音乐，1991 年解散。

2002 年入选摇滚名人堂时有一次重组演出。

body.en:
Weymouth later recalled Lou Reed giving advice during CBGB residencies, including a line about putting a girl in the band.

The quote sits beside the early Sire years, not instead of the records.
body.zh:
Weymouth 后来回忆 CBGB 驻演期间 Lou Reed 给过建议，包括一句关于「乐队里放个女孩」的话。

引语旁证早期 Sire 年，不替代唱片。

title.en: Radiohead name and later art-rock cite
title.zh: Radiohead 队名与后来 art-rock 引用

body.en:
A song from True Stories gave Oxford’s On a Friday—later Radiohead—its name. Later art-rock cites Remain in Light density and dance-grid writing.

CBGB tightness scaled to polyrhythm albums under Eno.
body.zh:
《True Stories》中一首歌成为牛津 On a Friday——后来的 Radiohead——的队名。后来 art-rock 常引用《Remain in Light》的密度与舞曲节奏写法。

CBGB 紧凑在 Eno 下扩到复合节奏专辑。

note.en: RISD friends; June 1975 CBGB open for Ramones; Sire; Psycho Killer-era three-piece.
note.zh: RISD 友人；1975 年 6 月 CBGB 为 Ramones 暖场；Sire；《Psycho Killer》时期三人组。

note.en: Harrison from Modern Lovers; Eno trilogy through Speaking in Tongues, Stop Making Sense, Naked; split 1991.
note.zh: Harrison 来自 Modern Lovers；Eno 三部曲至《Speaking in Tongues》《Stop Making Sense》《Naked》；1991 年解散。

note.en: Remain in Light; Eno-era polyrhythm as new-wave mass entry.
note.zh: 《Remain in Light》；Eno 时期复合节奏，new-wave 大众入口。

note.en: Art-school funk, Sire CBGB start, Eno studio looping without glam costume.
note.zh: 艺术学院 funk、Sire/CBGB 起点、Eno 录音室循环，无 glam 戏服。
